description: Synchronize watch states between connected users for linked TV shows
name: Watch State Sync
overview: Links TV shows between groups of two or more users. When any user in a group watches or marks an episode as (un)watched, all other users in the group are updated automatically. Manage connections from the Watch State Sync page in the admin dashboard.

versions.changelog:
Fix: editing a connection pre-selects the wrong show

seriesId from /WatchSync/connections had dashes while option values from
/WatchSync/series did not. selectByValue found no match and fell back to
the first filtered result, which could be a different show with a similar
name (e.g. Queen Charlotte instead of Bridgerton).

Fix: edit user dropdowns still not pre-filling

The users endpoint returns undashed GUIDs (32 chars) while the
connections endpoint returns dashed GUIDs (36 chars). Normalized
before comparison so the selection now matches correctly.

Bug fixes

- Admin page edit: user dropdowns now correctly pre-fill with the saved users
- Sync button copies class list from .btnPlaystate (excluding btnPlaystate and playstatebutton-played) for consistent theming across all Jellyfin themes

Bug fixes

- Admin page: editing a connection now correctly pre-fills the user dropdowns; placeholder only shows on new rows
- Sync button popup can now be closed with Escape, keyboard back, or the LG WebOS remote back button
- Sync button now uses the same class structure as native detail buttons for correct hover styling

Fix episode count inflation; sort connections list alphabetically

- Progress bar no longer inflates totals with virtual stub episodes
- Connection list is now sorted: groups by user names, shows within a group by series name

Initial stable release of Watch State Sync

Synchronises watch states between connected groups of users for linked TV shows.

**Features:**
- Connect any number of users to a show — when one watches an episode all others are updated automatically
- Initial OR-merge when a connection is created: episodes already watched by either user are immediately synced
- Episode progress bar and watch count visible on each connection in the admin page
- Link button in the detail page action bar showing who you are synced with
- Admin page accessible from the Jellyfin sidebar under Watch State Sync
